description: This Java class 'CurvedMotion' demonstrates moving a UI button along a curved path using Android animation APIs, including PathEvaluator and ObjectAnimator, with interaction handled via button click events.

classes.name: CurvedMotion
classes.description: Main activity class that manages button movement along a curved path with animation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up button click listener to animate button along a curved path.

methods.name: moveButton
methods.description: Toggles button position between top-left and bottom-right.

methods.name: setButtonLoc
methods.description: Setter method used by ObjectAnimator to update button position during animation.
